description: Keywords for myanmar_news_telegram_watcher.py Telegram alerts. Edit this file anytime; the watcher reloads it each poll cycle.
notes: Plain keywords are matched as substrings (case-insensitive by default).
match_fields may include: name, description, creators, labels.
Avoid very short tokens like "mm" — they cause false positives.
Only already-notified report ids are stored; changing keywords can alert on older matches.
